8299.title: Policy refusals lack a recovery notification; follow-up turns remain accepted
8299.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex bridge emits recovery hints only for authentication and rate-limit errors, so a typed policy error returns without a recovery notification.
8299.proposedFix: Keep the existing policy error category. Decide and version any dedicated refusal recovery contract across provider, runtime, server, UI and orchestration; do not automatically retry or reset refused context without an explicit policy. First obtain a redacted real event sequence to test the reported session behavior.
8299.caveats: A real provider refusal and session poisoning were not reproduced. The trusted fixture confirms a policy error and failed boundary, a missing recovery notification, and a successful subsequent turn. A full repository build hit unrelated SDK bootstrap ordering failures; targeted SDK builds and 94 existing provider tests passed.
